_comment: The Hammunition palette. Every value is sampled from the logo artwork
(docs/images/logo.png), not chosen beside it: brand and brand-ink are the
most common purple and amber among its opaque pixels, brand-deep is the
aubergine ink the whole drawing is outlined in (its single most common
colour), and paper is the cream of the lettering. Hammunition Hill's
palette (brand/palette.json there) was sampled from its own artwork the
same way and sits a few units away; each repository publishes what its
artwork measures, and the family is the shared hue, not an identical hex.
tests/test_brand.py holds the marks to these values.
